parameters.name: ActionType
parameters.description:
The action type. Valid values:

- **0**: allow
- **1**: block

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the custom rule.

parameters.name: NewFilePath
parameters.description: The new file path for file rename.

parameters.name: Platform
parameters.description:
The operating system type. Valid values:

- **windows**: Windows
- **linux**: Linux
- **all**: all

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: The port number. This parameter is deprecated.

parameters.name: PortStr
parameters.description: The port number. Valid values: **1 to 65535**.

parameters.name: TargetDefault
parameters.description:
Specifies whether machines are automatically added to the rule. Default value: add. Valid values:

- **add**: Automatically added by default.
- **del**: Not automatically added by default.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The rule type. Valid values:

- **1**: process hash
- **2**: command line
- **3**: process network
- **4**: file read/write
- **5**: registry operation
- **6**: dynamic-link library loading
- **7**: file rename
- **8**: network domain name
- **9**: network IP
- **10**: file path
